name: Types of Electric Vehicles
summary:
Types of Electric Vehicles" is an immersive VR training application designed to help learners understand the core categories of electric vehicles, including BEVs, HEVs, and PHEVs, through interactive and realistic simulations. Users can explore components, functionalities, and real-world applications in a hands-on virtual environment that enhances technical comprehension and engagement.
